name: What should I decide before contacting a contractor for a bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I decide before contacting a contractor for a bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before requesting an estimate, list the functional issues with your current space, determine your overall budget range, and gather reference photos for your preferred style. Decide early whether you want a tub-to-shower conversion, a double vanity, or specialized accessibility features like curbless entries and grab bars. Having rough dimensions and noting existing plumbing locations also helps. Clear preparation allows a general contractor like HH Remodeling to provide an accurate estimate and properly plan for framing, tile, drywall, and sub-trade requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Define your priority upgrades, target budget, and layout preferences, such as keeping existing fixture locations or converting a tub to a walk-in shower.
